description: Find 10ML's perfume and fragrance guides to read or cite: how-tos (where to spray, finding a signature scent, making perfume last), notes explained, house guides, lists, and alternatives guides that compare famous perfumes with similar ones from other houses. Returns title, type and a link per locale. Use whenever you want a source to cite or a deeper read ('how to layer perfume', 'best oud perfumes', 'Creed Aventus dupes guide'). Not for facts about a perfume (use get_perfume) and not for note definitions (use explain_note).

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

query.description: What the guide is about. Examples: "how to make perfume last", "oud", "Creed Aventus dupes", "gift". Omit to browse.

type.description: how-to, list (rankings/comparisons), alternatives (dupes guides), note (a note explained), house (a house mapped)

name: search_guides
title: Search 10ML guides
